description_en: Queries a list of evaluation tasks
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop list-evaluation-tasks --agent-space prod-agentspace --task-name trace_task_completion_eval --task-mode batch --data-type trace --status Running --next-token eyJsYXN0SWQiOjEyMywib2Zmc2V0IjoyMH0= --max-results 20 --channel default --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEvaluationTasks

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match condition for the task name
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称模糊搜索条件
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The evaluation task mode. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is `batch`
parameters.help_zh: 评估任务模式。不传时后端默认设置为 `batch`
parameters.name: task_mode

parameters.help_en: The data source type of the evaluation object. Set this parameter to `trace` for trace-based evaluation
parameters.help_zh: 评估对象的数据来源类型。链路 Trace 评估使用 `trace`
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the evaluation task status
parameters.help_zh: 评估任务状态过滤条件
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page, obtained from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 下一页分页 Token，来自上一次响应
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回条数。后端默认 20，最大 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the task source. If this parameter is not specified, tasks from the default source are queried
parameters.help_zh: 任务来源过滤条件。不传时查询默认来源任务
parameters.name: channel
